{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float, handling thousands separators
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check the distribution of customer_segment across channels
segment_channel_cross = pd.crosstab(sales_df['channel'], sales_df['customer_segment'])

# Check the conversion rate by channel
conversion_by_channel = sales_df.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()

# Check the conversion rate by customer_segment
conversion_by_segment = sales_df.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].mean()

# Print the results
print("Cross-tabulation of customer_segment by channel:")
print(segment_channel_cross)
print("\nConversion rate by channel:")
print(conversion_by_channel)
print("\nConversion rate by customer_segment:")
print(conversion_by_segment)"}
